en.answer:
It will have 0 ATK from that turn onwards.

When the effect of <<13346>> stops applying, the ATK of the Primal Being Token returns to its original value, but since its original value is "?", it will become 0. (The ATK will not return to 3000, but the DEF will remain to be 2000.)

~~~

If the ATK of a Primal Being Token is changed by one of the following card's effects, it will become 0 from the following turn onwards as well:
● <<8863>>
● <<8742>>
● <<21420>>'s ③rd effect
● <<16503>>'s ③rd effect
● <<16726>>'s ②nd effect
● <<16223>>'s ①st effect
● <<7898>>'s ②nd effect
● <<14948>>'s ③rd effect
● <<14512>>'s ①st effect
● <<11428>>'s ①st effect
● <<19050>>'s ②nd effect

~~~

Similarly, if a『change that monster's ATK to 0 until the end of the turn』or a『halve that monster's ATK until the end of the turn』effect is applied to one of the monsters summoned by the following card's effects, their ATK will become 0 from the following turn onwards:
● <<11077>>'s ②nd effectの『●』
● <<6558>>１つ目の『●』
● <<15992>>'s ②nd effect
● <<16415>>'s ①st effect
● <<9362>>'s ①st effect
● <<12504>>'s ①st effect
● <<5574>>
en.question: When my Primal Being Token with 3000 ATK and 2000 DEF that was Special Summoned to my field by the opponent declares an attack, and my opponent uses the『change that opponent's monster's ATK to 0, until the end of this turn』effect of their <<13346>>, what happens to the Primal Being Token's ATK during the next turn?
en.title: If the effect of <<13346>> is applied to a Primal Being Token, what will its ATK be after the turn has ended?
